subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 2: At-Takathur, Al-Qari'ah, madd letters and shaddah
source: Written for quran/y2 lesson 34 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Al-Qari'ah 101:1-4 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 34. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: ٱلْقَارِعَةُ (١) مَا ٱلْقَارِعَةُ (٢) وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْقَارِعَةُ (٣) يَوْمَ يَكُونُ ٱلنَّاسُ كَٱلْفَرَاشِ ٱلْمَبْثُوثِ (٤)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: And what can make you know what is the Striking Calamity?
It is the Day when people will be like moths, dispersed,

questions.q: Chunk and link Al-Qari'ah 101:1-4 with the teacher.
Listening turns: today's group says 101:1-4 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: say it softly 3 times looking, 3 times without.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: Name one good deed you will do today.
101:4 says on that Day people will be like ...
Think again: Al-Qari'ah describes a loud, striking Day. How should we get ready for the Day of Judgement?
questions.a: By believing, praying, being kind and doing good deeds every day.
